long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The telescope is mine and dusk is close, so I will go and sit by it before anyone else thinks of it.
The moon is only a thin crescent tonight, but I will stare at it through my telescope anyway and keep notes.

today.reason: The observing has to start at dusk, so I will walk to the telescope first and only then look up.
